gecko.visible_surface_material: Paper / cardstock book cover with fabric or leather spine
gecko.visible_surface_condition: Slightly textured paper cover, matte finish, clean and dry
evidence_used: Visual assessment of book scale and weight approximation (~0.4 kg)
Textured paper surface texture which introduces micro-roughness degrading dry adhesion
Rigid opposing parallel sidewalls suitable for gecko pad seating
gecko.calculation_summary: Estimated object mass ~0.4 kg, requiring a minimum frictional/adhesive holding force. F_normal = (Mass * g) / (2 * mu_effective), scaled up for imperfect dry-adhesion contact on textured paper.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: No authoritative mass is provided; visual scale is estimated from standard book dimensions.
Textured paper reduces gecko pad effective contact area compared to smooth glass or polished plastic.
Force command constrained within 0 to 8 N.
gecko.reasoning_trace: The gecko gripper relies on intimate contact with smooth, nonporous surfaces. The book cover is paper and possesses visible texture, reducing gecko effectiveness and requiring higher normal preload (3.5 N) to achieve sufficient adhesive/frictional engagement for lifting.

silicone.visible_surface_material: Paper / cardstock book cover with fabric or leather spine
silicone.visible_surface_condition: Slightly textured paper cover, matte finish, clean and dry
evidence_used: Visual assessment of book scale and estimated weight (~0.4 kg)
High-friction silicone pad capable of conforming to paper texture
Rigid opposing flat parallel book covers
silicone.calculation_summary: Estimated object mass ~0.4 kg. F_normal = (Mass * g) / (2 * mu_silicone_paper), using an estimated moderate friction coefficient for silicone against matte paper.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Silicone friction coefficient against paper is assumed standard without direct physical measurement.
Force command is within the 0 to 8 N hardware limit.
silicone.reasoning_trace: The silicone gripper accommodates surface texture through compliance and relies on friction rather than micro-structured dry adhesion. For a ~0.4 kg book with a textured paper cover, a moderate normal force of 4.2 N ensures reliable frictional grip without slip.

comparison_evidence: Book cover exhibits visible paper texture which degrades dry-adhesive micro-contact for the gecko gripper.
Silicone gripper accommodates surface texture and minor irregularities better than the rigid-backed gecko pad.
recommendation_summary: Both grippers can lift the book, but the silicone gripper is recommended because its high-friction elastomeric pad conforms better to the textured paper cover. The gecko gripper suffers performance degradation on textured or porous paper surfaces, requiring careful preload, whereas silicone provides robust frictional holding capacity with lower sensitivity to minor surface micro-roughness.
